rationale: Five notes from this quarter reach for the same concept — the editor's choice of what to drop — without naming it. The proposed evergreen pulls forward what they all imply.

proposed_evergreen.title: Editing as compression
proposed_evergreen.body: Editing is the editor's choice of what to drop. The choice is the work — preserving 'intent' is the wrong framing because intent is exactly what the editor and author may disagree on. See [[01H8X9]] for the rate-distortion analogy.
